title: Capture or Take
goal: A greeter you can call twice — while the greeting stays yours.
hints: Printing only needs to LOOK at greeting — the lightest capture is a shared borrow.
move gives the closure the String itself; || greeting gives it away on the first CALL. Both end badly here.
explanation: Closures capture as weakly as the body allows: printing borrows, so the plain closure is Fn — call it forever, greeting stays with main. `move` transfers the String into the closure, so main's final println loses it (E0382). And `|| greeting` returns the capture, consuming it on the first call: that closure is FnOnce, and the second greet() is a use-of-moved-closure. The body writes the contract; read it before you call twice.
